introHtml: Custom 20 oz mason jars offer a versatile size for serving iced tea, lemonade, or cocktails at corporate events. The 20 oz capacity hits the sweet spot between a standard 16 oz and larger 24 oz jars, making them ideal for gift sets or promotional giveaways. Personalize with screen printing or full-wrap labels to showcase your logo. Whether you’re marketing a new product or rewarding employees, these jars provide a rustic, reusable vessel that recipients keep.
